movie.title: Babita Singh Reporting
movie.overview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To attend a family celebration in Rewa, people-pleasing officer Baby takes a false charge for leave, only to be thrust into a dangerous murder investigation when her childhood friend is killed.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: People-pleasing cop Baby agrees to accept a fake charge at work just to secure leave for her sister-in-law's baby shower in Rewa. Her homecoming turns tragic when her childhood friend Bansi is murdered on the night of her arrival. Defying her unsupportive husband, dismissive in-laws, and apathetic local law enforcement, Baby launches a secret investigation into the crime. As she uncovers painful family betrayals, she gradually finds her voice, courage, and true identity as a capable detective.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Babita "Baby" Singh is a timid, people-pleasing police officer who constantly seeks approval from both her family and colleagues. Desperate to attend her sister-in-law's baby shower in Rewa, she makes the risky decision to accept a false disciplinary charge just to take official leave. Upon arriving in Rewa, she experiences a warm reunion with her childhood best friend, Bansi. However, the joy is short-lived when Bansi is mysteriously murdered that very same night. The local police force shows little interest in pursuing the truth, quickly writing off the case as an open-and-shut incident. Confronted by her indifferent husband and dismissive in-laws who urge her to stay out of trouble, Baby decides she cannot let her friend's death go unpunished. Operating entirely in secret, she begins gathering clues and interviewing witnesses across town on her own. Her clandestine probe unearths a web of deep-seated family betrayals and hidden motives that span years. In standing up to the corruption around her and pursuing justice for Bansi, Baby transforms from an overly agreeable subordinate into a fearless, self-assured investigator who finally claims her place as a true cop.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Babita "Baby" Singh is an earnest policewoman known more for her desire to please others than her authoritative presence. When she needs leave to attend a family milestone—her sister-in-law's baby shower in the town of Rewa—she resorts to taking the blame for a fake charge at work. Shortly after arriving in Rewa, Baby reconnects with her cherished childhood friend, Bansi, bringing back fond memories of her past. Tragedy strikes that very evening when Bansi is suddenly murdered under mysterious circumstances. Disillusioned by the local police force's apathy and apathy from her own husband and in-laws, who insist she stay out of police matters while on leave, Baby refuses to remain silent. Driven by loyalty and a growing sense of duty, she launches an independent, covert investigation into the crime. As Baby unravels hidden secrets and personal deceit, she undergoes a profound personal transformation, stepping out of the shadows of expectation to become a resilient, confident officer of the law.

story_structure.resolution: Having solved the crime, Baby sheds her people-pleasing nature, earning her respect and establishing her identity as a confident, capable police officer.
